summary: TIM S.A. filed a Form 6-K attaching minutes of a Fiscal Council meeting approving a proposal to distribute interest on shareholders' equity (IE). The distribution totals R$400 million (approx. $80 million USD), at R$0.1674573219 gross per share. Payment is scheduled by July 22, 2026, with a record date of June 22, 2026; shares acquired after that date trade ex-dividend. A 17.5% withholding tax applies unless exempt. The board's fiscal council expressed a favorable opinion. This is a routine capital return via IE, a common Brazilian corporate tax-advantaged distribution equivalent to a dividend. No special situation beyond standard dividend policy is present. What to watch: the net cash impact and any future recurring distributions, but no risk-arb angle exists.
